projects.description: This investment project aims to provide affordable loans to workers to enable them to purchase improved cooking stoves. These stoves are energy-efficient cost-effective and environmentally friendly compared to traditional cooking methods.The loan scheme will enable workers to acquire the stoves through affordable manageable installments paid over an agreed period. The initiative seeks to improve workers’ living conditions while promoting sustainable energy use and reducing household expenses related to cooking fuel

projects.description: The Iron Sheets Loan Project is designed to support workers in improving their housing conditions by providing affordable loans to purchase iron sheets (roofing materials). Through this initiative workers will access quality roofing materials and repay the cost in manageable installments over an agreed period. The project aims to promote safe durable and decent housing while reducing the financial burden of making large upfront payments. It also contributes to workers’ welfare dignity and long-term socio-economic stability.

projects.description: This project focuses on improving the productivity and sustainability of tea plantations through proper field maintenance practices and the application of organic manure. The investment includes activities such as plucking weeding soil conservation and the use of organic fertilizers (such as buying animal manure) to restore soil fertility. The project aims to enhance tea quality and yield while reducing dependence on chemical fertilizers and promoting environmentally friendly farming practices
